name: upload
description: Represents a file upload or send-to-cloud action. On hover, the arrow fires upward into a portal clip via a conveyor belt mechanism: the primary arrow exits the top while a clone rises seamlessly from below to take its place. The tray base stays static. Reverses on hover-leave.

animation.description: Two identical arrow paths stacked 16 SVG units apart share a motion.g. On hover, the group translates y: 0 → y: -16 (0.35s, cubic-bezier 0.65/0/0.35/1). An artboard clipPath (0–24) clips the primary arrow as it exits the top. A tray clipPath (0–18) keeps the clone invisible beneath the tray until it rises into view. Unique per-instance clipPath IDs via useId() prevent DOM conflicts. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: When used as a file upload trigger, pair with a visible label or progress indicator after activation.
